Who Is The GT73 Safety Edition Best For?

The Riding'times GT73 Safety Edition is designed for riders looking for a versatile electric dirt bike with a factory configured 15 MPH speed limit, dual battery system, pedals, full suspension, and all terrain capability.

It is a practical choice for riders who prefer a lower maximum powered speed for everyday riding, recreational use, outdoor exploration, camping trips, gravel paths, and permitted off road riding areas.

The GT73 Safety Edition keeps the rugged electric dirt bike design and versatile riding platform of the GT73 while adding a factory configured 15 MPH maximum powered speed.

For riders researching a 15 MPH electric bike, speed limited electric dirt bike, Class 2 electric bike speed requirements, dual battery electric bike, or electric dirt bike with pedals, the GT73 Safety Edition provides a dedicated lower speed configuration of the GT73 platform.

A 15 MPH Speed Limited Electric Dirt Bike

The GT73 Safety Edition is factory configured with a maximum powered speed of 15 MPH before shipment.

This lower speed configuration is designed for riders who want greater control over maximum speed while keeping the core features of the GT73.

The GT73 Safety Edition retains the GT73 electric dirt bike frame, dual battery system, pedals, full suspension, rugged tires, throttle control, and motorcycle inspired riding position.

Its 15 MPH factory speed setting also places its maximum powered speed below the commonly referenced 20 MPH speed threshold used in Class 2 electric bike definitions in the United States.

Electric bike classification can also depend on motor power, throttle operation, operable pedals, equipment, labeling, and state or local regulations. Riders should always check applicable regulations before using an electric bike on public roads, bike lanes, parks, or trails.

A Versatile Outdoor Electric Dirt Bike

The GT73 Safety Edition is designed for riders who want one electric bike that can support multiple types of recreational riding.

It can be used for relaxed neighborhood rides where permitted, outdoor exploration, gravel paths, camping trips, private property riding, and recreational adventures.

The combination of a 15 MPH factory speed limit, dual batteries, pedals, suspension, and all terrain electric dirt bike design gives the GT73 Safety Edition a broad range of potential uses.

For riders comparing electric dirt bikes, electric bikes with pedals, speed limited electric bikes, and all terrain electric bikes, the GT73 Safety Edition offers a flexible platform designed around controlled recreational riding.

Why A 15 MPH Speed Limit Matters

Maximum speed can significantly affect how an electric bike feels during everyday and recreational riding.

The GT73 Safety Edition is configured with a maximum powered speed of 15 MPH before shipment. This provides a lower speed range for riders who prefer a more controlled riding setup.

A 15 MPH speed limit may appeal to riders who prefer relaxed recreational riding, families looking for greater control over maximum speed, or riders who simply do not need the higher top speed available from the standard GT73 configuration.

The 15 MPH setting is also below the commonly referenced 20 MPH maximum assisted speed associated with Class 2 electric bike speed requirements.

Class 2 electric bikes are commonly associated with throttle equipped electric bicycles where motor assistance stops at a maximum speed of 20 MPH.

The GT73 Safety Edition is factory configured with a maximum powered speed of 15 MPH, placing its speed below that commonly referenced Class 2 speed threshold.

Riders researching a Class 2 electric bike should consider several factors in addition to maximum speed.

A Dual Battery Electric Dirt Bike With Pedals

A dual battery electric bike provides riders with additional battery capacity for longer recreational rides and outdoor exploration.

The GT73 Safety Edition also retains pedals, making it an electric dirt bike with pedals for riders who want greater flexibility during different riding situations.

Combined with its suspension, rugged tires, electric dirt bike frame, and factory configured 15 MPH speed setting, the GT73 Safety Edition brings together several features shoppers commonly compare when looking for an outdoor electric bike.

For riders researching a dual battery electric bike, electric dirt bike with pedals, 15 MPH electric bike, speed limited electric dirt bike, or all terrain electric bike, the GT73 Safety Edition combines these features in one platform.

Why Versatility Matters

Its electric dirt bike frame and all terrain design support outdoor recreation, while its factory configured 15 MPH speed limit provides a lower maximum powered speed for riders who prefer a more controlled setup.

How The GT73 Safety Edition Fits Into The Riding'times Lineup

Within the Riding'times lineup, the GT73 Safety Edition serves as the factory speed limited version of the GT73 electric dirt bike.

It is designed for riders who like the GT73 platform, dual battery system, pedals, suspension, and all terrain styling while preferring a maximum powered speed of 15 MPH.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the GT73 Safety Edition?

The Riding'times GT73 Safety Edition is a factory speed limited version of the GT73 electric dirt bike.

It is configured with a maximum powered speed of 15 MPH before shipment while retaining the core GT73 platform, including its dual battery system, pedals, suspension, rugged tires, and electric dirt bike design.

Can the GT73 be limited to 15 MPH?

Yes. The GT73 Safety Edition is configured with a maximum powered speed of 15 MPH before shipment.

This gives riders a dedicated lower speed GT73 configuration without requiring them to configure the maximum speed themselves after receiving the bike.

Is the GT73 Safety Edition a 15 MPH electric dirt bike?

Yes. The GT73 Safety Edition is factory configured with a maximum powered speed of 15 MPH.

It retains the GT73 electric dirt bike platform, dual battery system, pedals, suspension, and all terrain design.

Is the GT73 Safety Edition a Class 2 electric bike?

The GT73 Safety Edition has a factory configured maximum powered speed of 15 MPH, which is below the commonly referenced 20 MPH maximum assisted speed used in Class 2 electric bike definitions.

Class 2 classification can also depend on motor power, throttle operation, operable pedals, equipment, labeling, and applicable state or local regulations.

Riders should confirm the requirements in their riding location before using the GT73 Safety Edition on public roads, bike lanes, parks, or trails.

What is the Class 2 electric bike speed limit?

Class 2 electric bikes are commonly associated with a maximum motor assisted speed of 20 MPH when using throttle power.

Additional requirements can apply to motor power, pedals, equipment, labeling, and vehicle configuration.

State and local laws may also establish additional restrictions.

Is 15 MPH below the Class 2 electric bike speed limit?

Yes. A maximum powered speed of 15 MPH is below the commonly referenced 20 MPH Class 2 speed threshold.

Maximum speed is only one factor used when determining electric bike classification.

Why is the GT73 Safety Edition limited to 15 MPH?

The GT73 Safety Edition uses a factory configured 15 MPH maximum powered speed for riders who prefer a lower maximum speed and a more controlled riding setup.

It allows riders to keep the core GT73 platform while selecting a lower speed configuration.

What is the difference between the GT73 and GT73 Safety Edition?

The main difference is the factory configured maximum powered speed.

The GT73 Safety Edition is configured with a maximum powered speed of 15 MPH before shipment.

It retains the core GT73 electric dirt bike platform, including the dual battery system, pedals, suspension, rugged tires, and major hardware.

Is the GT73 Safety Edition good for beginners?

The 15 MPH factory speed limit may appeal to riders who prefer a lower maximum powered speed and a more controlled riding setup.

Suitability still depends on rider experience, rider size, riding conditions, protective equipment, supervision, and the environment where the bike will be used.

Can the GT73 Safety Edition be used for outdoor adventures?

Yes. The GT73 Safety Edition is designed for recreational riding, outdoor exploration, gravel paths, camping trips, private property, and other riding environments where this type of electric bike is permitted.

Is the GT73 Safety Edition suitable for trail riding?

The GT73 Safety Edition can be used on suitable recreational trails, gravel paths, and off road riding areas where this type of electric vehicle is permitted.

Trail access rules vary by location, so riders should check local regulations and trail rules before riding.

Does the GT73 Safety Edition have pedals?

Yes. The GT73 Safety Edition retains the pedal equipped design of the GT73.

This makes it an electric dirt bike with pedals as well as a factory speed limited electric bike.

Does the GT73 Safety Edition have dual batteries?

Yes. The GT73 Safety Edition retains the dual battery platform of the GT73.

The dual battery system is designed to provide additional battery capacity for longer recreational rides and outdoor exploration.

Is the GT73 Safety Edition an off road electric dirt bike?

The GT73 Safety Edition uses the rugged frame, suspension, tires, and electric dirt bike design of the GT73 and can be used for recreational off road riding in permitted locations.

Riders should check local access rules before using the bike on trails, parks, public land, or other regulated areas.

Who should choose the GT73 Safety Edition?

The GT73 Safety Edition is designed for riders who want the GT73 electric dirt bike platform with a factory configured 15 MPH maximum powered speed.

It may appeal to riders searching for a 15 MPH electric bike, speed limited electric dirt bike, dual battery electric bike, all terrain electric bike, electric dirt bike with pedals, or riders researching Class 2 electric bike speed requirements.

What makes the GT73 Safety Edition different from the GT73 Pro Safety Edition?

The GT73 Safety Edition focuses on the standard GT73 platform and its balance of everyday versatility and outdoor recreational capability.

The GT73 Pro Safety Edition uses the upgraded GT73 Pro platform with its corresponding Pro level hardware and specifications.

Both Safety Edition models can be offered with a factory configured 15 MPH maximum powered speed, allowing riders to choose the GT73 platform that better matches their preferred features and riding needs.
